package.basis: Desk only, not played: Steam store page and review API (English 3,130 reviews, 93% positive; 300 sampled), a Steam discussion thread on idling, the iOS App Store listing (IAP list), and one press review.

fun.source: desk estimate: well below Loop Hero (74.0) and Melvor Idle (65.4) because it neither idles truly (no auto-restart, no real offline) nor offers deep active play, and late dimensions read as grind; clearly above the mediocre idle RPG card (30.8) on charm, party building and Soda Scripts

evidence.quote: No Ads Bundle: $5.99 ... Magic Clock Bundle: $4.99 ... 1100 Caps: $9.99
The credits will only let you re-run cleared levels.
[rec 191059932] you would have to pay or cheat to get the magic clock within the first 30 something hours of playing

dims.note: Free with ads, caps packs and a paid Magic Clock speed-up; no true offline (battle credits replay cleared floors only), no auto-restart, a party wipe ends the idle run (prior research). Store says everything is earnable in-game, so the clock is acceleration earnable later rather than a strict paid skip of a created wait; kill flag left false but this is borderline.

learn.practice: Without automatic restart an idle dungeon becomes a chore; Soda Dungeon 2's top idle complaint. Auto-resend after death/return must be the default once earned.
learn.evidence: https://steamcommunity.com/app/946050/discussions/0/3463848715776669640/ This game needs attention every few minutes. ... If the dungeons don't restart then this is not idle.

learn.practice: Party AI scripts give a configuration ceiling players love even in a light game; expose rule bundles as editable scripts late, with clear teaching.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/946050?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 217593504] While it's confusing to figure out at first, the power of scripts in this game should not be underestimated

learn.practice: Never sell the speed the game deliberately withholds; the paid Magic Clock is the most cited reason for distrust.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/946050?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 195587680] I'd rather pay for a quality game, then have gameplay "purposely be slow", to promote microtansaction skips

learn.practice: Save robustly: write-then-swap with backups; a save wipe on unexpected close ends an idle game's relationship with the player.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/946050?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 191727146] If the game closed unexpectedly while running, your save is wiped. Everything.
